facts.fact: BCEAO reports UEMOA electronic-money accounts reached 248 million in 2024, with 76.9 million active, in a region that includes Guinea-Bissau.
BCEAO says interoperable e-money transactions in UEMOA, which includes Guinea-Bissau, go through PI-SPI, with 175 connected participants including banks, e-money issuers and payment institutions.
